evidence.reason: The fixture creates a temporary repository and runs `git commit` without disabling repo-local commit signing. Git inherits a global `commit.gpgSign=true`; when signing is enabled but no signing key matches the fixture identity (`fixture@example.invalid`), the commit fails and every `DeployTests` case errors in `setUp()`. This is an ordinary test-fixture hermeticity defect, and setting repository-local `commit.gpgSign=false` is the smallest compatible fix.
